notes: Account: mid-market product analytics platform. Heavy realtime search and support use cases.
Currently on a competitor LLM API (OpenAI). Looking to migrate to Redwood Hosted initially for parity tests, then Dedicated for cost/throughput.
Primary drivers: reduce per-token cost, predictable latency under load, data controls (VPC), and better observability for prompt regressions.
Key stakeholders: CTO (Priya Menon), Head of ML infra (Daniel Park), Product lead (Sara Blake), Eng manager (Tom Willis).
Quotes: 'We need 95th pctile latency <200ms for chat flows' - Tom. 'Regressions are our biggest fear; we have automated prompt suites.' - Priya.
Security asks: SOC2 + KMS integration, SSO/SAML, audit logs, retention policy + ability to keep logs in our VPC.
Initial eval plan: Hosted API POC (2 weeks) -> parallel compare against OpenAI on 50 canonical prompts -> measure latency, token usage, semantic parity, cost delta.
Post-POC: migrate to Dedicated reserved capacity if parity achieved and infra savings justify commit. Interested in burst capacity and autoscaling policies.
Integration notes: internal SDK wraps OpenAI-like interface; need compat layer or small shim to minimize code changes. Concern about prompt formatting/tokenization differences affecting outputs.
SE asks: provide guidance on quantization/model variants that preserve output fidelity (we use gpt-like open models today), provide example canary rollout for critical prompts.
Pricing convo: prefer committed monthly with a 12-month uplift. Asked for scenario-based cost models: 1000 qps with 25 token avg, 24/7 Chat traffic spikes.
Next steps agreed on call 2026-02-20: schedule POC kickoff 2026-02-27, provide Hosted API keys + integration checklist + prebuilt parity test harness (Jupyter).
Potential blockers: internal legal needs DPA update, want data residency clause for EU customers, infosec SOC2 attestation timeline unknown.
References: Fireflies notes + demo recording linked. Jira for compat work pre-created (JIRA-RED-8741).
Internal AE notes: prioritize handing off to Solutions Eng early (Marco) to accelerate shim + parity tests. Track prompt regression metrics and save failing examples.
Customer pilot success metrics: parity score >=95% on semantic equivalence for 50 prompts, <10% change in token consumption, 95th pctile latency <250ms on Hosted; Dedicated target <150ms.
Longer term: evaluate Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching/caching) to further cut token spend; plan 6-month migration timeline if POC successful.
